source_facts: Official vLLM documents distinct chat completions and embeddings APIs; embeddings requires actual embedding model, chat requires text-generation model/chat template. GLM5.2 official model card shows compatible chat endpoint. These API documents are protocol references, not pinned local server/model artifacts or evidence that a private endpoint is configured.

Each route already protected private eligible capability (text-generation vs embedding), exact recipient endpoint/account/credential/current privacy proof and private consent. profile/namespace/provider/owner generation exact current joins, no root-global engines{} fallback.
selection_source: Root setup explicit private endpoint selection consumes existing actual provider endpoint ownership/deployment receipt and current eligible route receipt; no caller model ID, dimensions, privacy bool or endpoint declaration can mint readiness. Required extraction model is GLM-5.2 (zai-org/GLM-5.2 or exact served alias bound by actual deployment artifact). Embedding model separately selected actual immutable model/deployment/license/runtime receipt with exact served model+dimensions; no default invented model or GLM embedding substitution. Missing actual model/deployment/ownership/license/ARM proof keeps selection pending. No model/server/package downloads or new metered service provisioning authorized by this protocol refinement.

Implements existing extract(text,context,timeout,cancelled)->list[str], embed(facts,context,timeout,cancelled)->list[list[float]]. Root dispatcher checks actual current job consent/source ancestry/private route capability/model/dimensions/endpoint on EVERY request and retry then fresh effect; extraction output inherits private source closure and embedding does not declassify.
